title: Clueless Couple Escalates Situation with Police in Absurd Fashion
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On May 8th, 2023. An officer pulled in a Wawa gas station because he had to use the bathroom. On his way back, he noticed a car that was tinted up & proceeded to observe the vehicle. (Please note, the couple did not commit any traffic offence as they were parked at a gas station). When the officer was walking around observing the vehicle, the woman got out and started yelling at the officers. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
